# DIRECTIONS: SNAP-a = astrocyte part, SNAP-n = neuron part of Ling's LF4 loadings; lower SNAP = direction of schizophrenia and ageing. Estimated agonal score: HIGHER = more agonal. pH-axis score: HIGHER = higher-pH-like (gene weights z > 0 = higher at higher pH), so NEGATIVE correlation = part is HIGHER at LOW pH. Measured pH: higher = higher pH. SZ effect in SD of the score (negative = lower in schizophrenia).

# pooling: single-nucleus = Fisher z weights n-3 with bootstrap within bank x diagnosis (correlations), inverse-variance fixed effect (SZ effect); bulk = equal-weight mean of cluster means, bootstrap over clusters (2,000)
